note: Manual record. One entry per feature check. result = verified | approximate | wrong. Tools read this and never write it.

example.method: Google Earth Pro imagery dated YYYY-MM-DD | on-course GPS walk

pre_restoration_evidence.method: Imagery overlay (outlines drawn on the image in the hole's UTM grid): MassGIS 2025 orthoimagery, 18 Mar 2025, 7.5 cm, seen through Esri World Imagery (metadata: 'Massachusetts 2025 Images', accuracy 0.034 m). Taken BEFORE the tee and bunker reconstruction (owner: restoration done spring 2026; no public imagery after it), so it shows the old layout only.
pre_restoration_evidence.ref: Outline on the mown green edge all round.

evidence_note: Evidence entries do not change geometry_status. They show the source map was traced from the pre-restoration course (all 8 outlines within about 0.5-1 m of the Mar 2025 image). Current positions need an on-course check (V3 field-check mode) or post-restoration imagery.
